sql_templates.description: Fetch insider alerts and bulk deals for the last 20 sessions with technical scores.
sql_templates.template:
WITH latest_snapshot AS (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) AS max_snapshot_date FROM scores.stage_snapshots), 
insider_alerts AS (SELECT symbol, alert_date, qty, value_cr FROM signals.insider_alerts WHERE alert_date > CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '20 days'), 
bulk_deals AS (SELECT symbol, deal_date, qty, price FROM signals.bulk_block_deals WHERE deal_date > CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '20 days'), 
latest_scores AS (SELECT symbol, stage, stage_score, technical_score, trading_signal FROM scores.stage_snapshots WHERE snapshot_date = (SELECT max_snapshot_date FROM latest_snapshot) AND trading_signal IN ('BUY', 'STRONG_BUY')), 
selected_symbols AS (SELECT DISTINCT ia.symbol FROM insider_alerts ia JOIN bulk_deals bd ON ia.symbol = bd.symbol) 
SELECT ss.symbol, ss.stage, ss.stage_score, ss.technical_score FROM latest_scores ss JOIN selected_symbols sym ON ss.symbol = sym.symbol;

sql_templates.name: sector_breadth_analysis
sql_templates.template:
WITH recent_breadth AS (
    SELECT sector, pct_above_50dma, change_5d, breadth_signal, divergence_alert
    FROM breadth.sector_daily
    WHERE snapshot_date > CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '3 months'
),
latest_stages AS (
    SELECT symbol, sector
    FROM scores.stage_snapshots
    WHERE snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM scores.stage_snapshots) AND stage = 'STAGE_2' AND trading_signal IN ('BUY', 'STRONG_BUY')
)
SELECT rb.sector, rb.pct_above_50dma, rb.change_5d, rb.breadth_signal, ls.symbol
FROM recent_breadth rb
JOIN latest_stages ls ON rb.sector = ls.sector
LIMIT 100;
